countries.flag: the sub-themes cover almost every country; only Georgia (Caucasus, neither clearly European nor Asian, not landlocked) is left. Disputed states (Kosovo, Taiwan, Palestine) left out on purpose.

european countries.flag: only 4: the countries not clearly eastern or western (Balkan/southern edge). Everything else is in the two sub-themes.

african countries.flag: lists only North and Central African countries plus the Indian Ocean islands and Mauritania, which are not clearly in the west/east/southern sub-themes.

east african countries.flag: only 10 clear members; Madagascar, Mauritius, Seychelles, Comoros, Malawi, Mozambique and Zambia are sometimes counted as East Africa but went elsewhere to avoid debate.

french-speaking countries.flag: only countries where French is an official language; Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and Mauritius (widely French-speaking but not official) left out.

cities.flag: sub-themes cover nearly all cities; this keeps inland Mexican, Caribbean and Siberian cities. Siberian cities are geographically Asian, but most players would file them as Russian.
